description: This file defines data models and configuration classes related to Single Sign-On (SSO) settings, access control, and team parameters within the litellm project. It includes Pydantic models for various SSO configurations, Microsoft Graph API objects, and access control modes.

classes.name: LiteLLM_UpperboundKeyGenerateParams
classes.description: Model for setting default upperbound parameters for key generation via API.

classes.name: MicrosoftGraphAPIUserGroupDirectoryObject
classes.description: Model representing a Microsoft Graph API directory object for user groups.

classes.name: MicrosoftGraphAPIUserGroupResponse
classes.description: Model for the response containing user groups from Microsoft Graph API.

classes.name: MicrosoftServicePrincipalTeam
classes.description: Model for representing a Microsoft Service Principal Team.

classes.name: AccessControl_UI_AccessMode
classes.description: Model for controlling UI access mode via SSO groups.

classes.name: SSOConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for SSO environment variables and settings, including OAuth client IDs, secrets, endpoints, and access mode.

classes.name: DefaultTeamSSOParams
classes.description: Default parameters for automatically created teams via SSO groups, including models, budgets, and limits.
